## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

One of several Qing-period commentarial works on the *Chánlín bǎoxùn*, alongside [KR6q0153](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6q/KR6q0153), [KR6q0154](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6q/KR6q0154), [KR6q0155](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6q/KR6q0155), [KR6q0157](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6q/KR6q0157).

**Abstract**
